In previous World Cups, Croatia entered as the unfancied side, but surprised many by finishing as the runner-up in 2018 before a third-place finish in 2022. These outings have raised the expectations back home for the Vatreni, whose tactical discipline has proved to be a headache for the tournament favourites in the latter stages as England found out in the 2018 semifinals in Russia.

[...]
Head coach Zlatko Dalic, who will be managing Croatia into his third World Cup, has also retained the core from the 2022 set-up. Goalkeeper Dominik Livakovic, defender Josko Gvardiol, midfielders Modric, Mateo Kovacic and Mario Pasalic, and forwards Perisic and Kramaric will form a formidable spine, tallying a combined 665 international caps between them.

##### Predicted playing XI (4-2-3-1)
[...]
Even at 40, Modric, who will be taking part in his fifth World Cup, is still the heartbeat of this Croatian side. The AC Milan playmaker will set the tone for Croatia’s tempo from the middle of the park. He was named the best player in the 2018 World Cup before going on to win the Ballon d’Or the same year. While he may not play the full 90 minutes as he did in previous tournaments, Croatia will back him to still wield influence while out on the pitch.
[...]
After an unusual managerial route which saw him work in Saudi Arabia and the UAE, Dalic has now been at the helm of the Croatian senior team for nine years. With a generation of highly technical midfielders at his disposal, Croatia has been able to assert control with its possession-heavy style, making it a hard-to-beat side in recent years.

Croatia arrive at the 2026 World Cup as one of football’s most consistent overachievers, yet the outright betting market reflects genuine uncertainty about whether this ageing squad can replicate past heroics.
[...]
At 90/1 to lift the trophy, Croatia sit 18th in the outright market. That price acknowledges their pedigree while pricing in the difficult group draw and the physical demands of an expanded 48-team format on a squad with several players in their mid-to-late thirties.

- Confidence: 3/5
- Best Odds: 10/3 (Group L Winner as a starting point)
- Reason: Croatia’s tournament experience and midfield quality make a last-eight run more likely than their outright price suggests.
[...]
Croatia are drawn in Group L alongside England, Panama, and Ghana. Their campaign opens with the toughest fixture: England on 17 June in Dallas (Arlington). That game could effectively define their tournament. A positive result there would leave Croatia well-placed to qualify ahead of the final two matches against Panama in Toronto and Ghana in Philadelphia.
[...]
Based on squad depth and recent form, Croatia are credible candidates to advance as group winners or runners-up. If they progress, the Round of 32 and Round of 16 should see them face manageable opposition before the real test arrives at the quarter-final stage. It is there, against a South American or another top European side, that Croatia’s ageing midfield faces its stiffest examination.
[...]
Given this projected path, the quarter-final stage looks like the most realistic ceiling for this squad, which makes stage-of-elimination markets considerably more attractive than the outright at 90/1. results.title: World Cup 2026 Ultimate Guide: Croatia | Goal.com US
highlights:
An almost flawless qualifying campaign and statistics that speak for themselves. Croatia’s journey to the 2026 World Cup was virtually perfect. The Balkan side secured qualification with seven wins and just one draw, scoring 26 goals while conceding only four.
[...]
Croatian football continues to prove itself as one of the most productive and successful systems in both Europe and the world, as reflected by the national team's achievements over the past decade, which includes a World Cup final appearance, a further run to the semi-finals and two trips to the knockouts of the Euros.
[...]
After finishing runners-up to France in 2018 and claiming third place in Qatar four years later, Croatia arrive at this World Cup no longer as dark horses, but as a team with genuine ambitions and expectations.
[...]
Recent results reinforce the belief that Croatia can once again play a leading role on football’s biggest stage. While the golden generation that reached the 2018 final has largely moved on, the country's impressive talent pipeline continues to produce players capable of competing at the highest level.
[...]
What better stage than the World Cup to showcase that quality and continuity? The disappointment of an early exit at the most recent Euros still lingers, but Croatia now have an opportunity to make amends - and do so in emphatic fashion.
[...]
Croatia remain under the guidance of Zlatko Dalic, who has been in charge since October 2017. Now preparing for his third World Cup, Dalic recently celebrated his 100th match in charge of the national team and is once again aiming for the ultimate prize after coming so close in the past.
[...]
, Dalic has narrowly missed out on major silverware twice, both at the 2018 World Cup and in the 2023 Nations League

His preferred 4-2-3-1 formation forms the foundation of a football philosophy built on technical quality, possession and attractive play, always with the objective of achieving results.

At 40 years old, Luka Modric remains the beating heart of Croatia. After dazzling Serie A during his debut season at AC Milan, Modric once again brings his experience and extraordinary vision to the national team, qualities that have kept him among the world's elite for more than 15 years.
[...]
Winner of the Ballon d'Or in 2018 and the embodiment of quiet leadership, Modric belongs to the generation that delivered some of the greatest moments in Croatian football history. Heading into his fifth World Cup, Modric knows that this tournament will likely be his last on the international stage.
